Wide panoramic distant landscape backdrop painting for a 3D game, hand-painted soft painterly style like a modern anime-inspired RPG, golden-afternoon light, aerial perspective with pale lavender-blue haze. Rolling autumn hills with golden fields and small birch groves, and on the highest far hill in the centre a quiet stone cloister with a tall square clock-bell tower with a round clock face without numbers, slender roofs, cypress-like dark trees. Only the land: everything above the hills is a plain flat solid pure white background (no sky, no clouds, no sun). Nothing in the foreground, no people, no text.
